sources.title: SRFI 45 delay, lazy, and force
sources.sections_read: Status; Abstract; Solution; Specification; reference implementation and reentrancy examples
sources.confirmed: SRFI 45 defines promises that defer arbitrary expressions until forced, memoize results, and compose lazy steps using iterative forcing. Its example constructs a delayed computation before a later variable definition and forces it afterward.
sources.limits: This is a Scheme mechanism to translate, not a Python annotation implementation; captured environments, side-effect timing, cycles, and exception behavior need an explicit Python contract. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: pre_decision. Original read and any failures remain in runs/A/C14.json.

sources.title: CPython 3.6.3 _ForwardRef and get_type_hints
sources.version_or_date: CPython tag v3.6.3; matching documentation dated 2017-10-03
sources.sections_read: _ForwardRef initialization and _eval_type; get_type_hints; no_type_check; TYPE_CHECKING assignment
sources.confirmed: The implementation compiles strings without evaluating their names, resolves them later using explicit namespaces, and caches some resolutions. Its validator requires type-like results, so it is not directly a general-purpose arbitrary-annotation evaluator.
sources.limits: Users still need quoted expressions; some compilation cost remains, resolution requires the correct namespace, and its type validator cannot directly serve arbitrary non-type annotation values. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: pre_decision. Original read and any failures remain in runs/A/C14.json.

sources.title: Angular 4.4.6 forwardRef and resolveForwardRef
sources.confirmed: Angular marks a zero-argument callback as a forward reference and invokes it when resolution is requested; ordinary values pass through. The function result type is unrestricted, and the code does not memoize callback results.
sources.limits: It requires explicit wrappers, does not memoize callback results, and only works if resolution happens after the referenced binding is ready; adapting syntax and scope to Python remains work. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: pre_decision. Original read and any failures remain in runs/A/C14.json.

sources.title: SQLAlchemy 1.1.15 deferred relationship arguments
sources.sections_read: RelationshipProperty callable/string documentation; mapper memoized property; _process_dependent_arguments
sources.confirmed: SQLAlchemy accepts callbacks and string references for configuration that needs classes declared later, resolving them when mapping is initialized. Its class registry supplies a lookup namespace, and mapper resolution is memoized.
sources.limits: The registry and initialization trigger are ORM-specific; a language-level adaptation must define scope retention and when errors occur, and cannot inherit ORM restrictions on accepted metadata. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: pre_decision. Original read and any failures remain in runs/A/C14.json.
